content.text:
The site matches the approved screenshots again. Both visual tests (desktop and phone) pass. Two values in `site/css/styles.css` had been changed from their Bootstrap defaults:

- **`.lead`** (line 490): `font-size` was `1.875rem`. I set it back to `1.25rem`. The subtitle had grown too large and wrapped onto two lines on the phone.
- **`.container`** (line 637): `width` was `150%`. I set it back to `100%`. This made the page 585px wide on a 390px phone, so it overflowed sideways.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
